New Release Alert

Employee Mispunch
script:
def execute():
    check_date = add_days(getdate(), -1)
    start_time = str(check_date) + " 00:00:00"
    end_time = str(check_date) + " 23:59:59"

    log_details = []

    employees = frappe.db.get_all(
        "Employee Checkin",
        filters={"time": ["between", [start_time, end_time]]},
        distinct=True,
        pluck="employee"
    )

    for emp in employees:
        # Get all check-ins for that employee and date
        checkins = frappe.get_all(
            "Employee Checkin",
            filters={"employee": emp, "time": ["between", [start_time, end_time]]},
            fields=["time", "log_type"],
            order_by="time asc"
        )

        if not checkins:
            log_details.append(f"{emp} → Skipped (no checkins)")
            continue

        att_name = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Attendance", {"employee": emp, "attendance_date": check_date}, "name"
        )

        if not att_name:
            log_details.append(f"{emp} → Skipped (no attendance)")
            continue

        att = frappe.get_doc("Attendance", att_name)
        has_out = any(c["log_type"] == "OUT" for c in checkins)

        # 👉 Replace 'custom_mispunch' with your actual fieldname
        if len(checkins) == 1 or not has_out:
            att.db_set("custom_mispunch", 1)
            log_details.append(f"{emp} → Mispunch marked ✅")
        else:
            att.db_set("custom_mispunch", 0)
            log_details.append(f"{emp} → Normal (no mispunch)")

        # Save & submit
        if att.docstatus == 0:
            att.submit()

    frappe.db.commit()

    frappe.log_error(
        title="Mispunch Debug Log",
        message="\n".join(log_details)
    )

script:
# --- After Submit Script: Job Card ---
# Purpose: Automatically create separate CMPR per Job Card (supports multiple lots per Work Order)

if (doc.status in ["Completed", "Submitted"] or doc.docstatus == 1) and doc.work_order:

    def to_float(val):
        try:
            return float(val or 0)
        except Exception:
            return 0.0

    # --- Step 1: Check Work Order Operation Type ---
    wo_operation = frappe.db.get_value("Work Order", doc.work_order, "custom_operation_type") or ""
    if wo_operation != "Coating":
        frappe.msgprint(f"Skipping CMPR creation: Operation Type is '{wo_operation}', not 'Coating'.")
    else:
        # --- Step 2: Identify Fabric Lot + Quilon & Adhesive batches ---
        cloth_lot = None
        total_fabric_qty = 0.0
        quilon_batch = None
        adhesive_batch = None

        # Fetch all submitted Material Transfer for Manufacture entries for this Work Order
        stock_entries = frappe.get_all(
            "Stock Entry",
            filters={
                "work_order": doc.work_order,
                "docstatus": 1,
                "purpose": "Material Transfer for Manufacture"
            },
            fields=["name", "creation"],
            order_by="creation asc"
        )

        # Find existing CMPR lots to skip used ones
        used_lots = frappe.get_all(
            "Coating Machine Production Record",
            filters={"work_order": doc.work_order},
            pluck="cloth_lot"
        )
        used_lots = [lot.strip() for lot in ",".join(used_lots).split(",") if lot] if used_lots else []

        # Pick next unused Fabric Lot and capture Quilon/Adhesive batches
        for se in stock_entries:
            se_items = frappe.get_all(
                "Stock Entry Detail",
                filters={"parent": se.name},
                fields=["item_code", "batch_no", "qty"]
            )

            for row in se_items:
                item_code = row.get("item_code") or ""
                batch_no = row.get("batch_no") or ""
                qty_val = to_float(row.get("qty"))
                material_type = frappe.db.get_value("Item", item_code, "custom_material_type")

                if material_type == "Fabric" and batch_no and batch_no not in used_lots and not cloth_lot:
                    cloth_lot = batch_no
                    total_fabric_qty = qty_val

                elif material_type == "Quilon" and batch_no and not quilon_batch:
                    quilon_batch = batch_no

                elif material_type == "Adhesive" and batch_no and not adhesive_batch:
                    adhesive_batch = batch_no

            if cloth_lot and quilon_batch and adhesive_batch:
                break

        # Fallback if not found
        cloth_lot = cloth_lot or (doc.get("custom_cloth_lot") or "N/A")

        # --- Step 3: Check again if CMPR already exists for this Work Order + Lot ---
        existing_cmpr = frappe.db.exists(
            "Coating Machine Production Record",
            {"work_order": doc.work_order, "cloth_lot": cloth_lot}
        )

        if existing_cmpr:
            frappe.msgprint(f"⚠️ CMPR already exists for Work Order {doc.work_order} and Lot {cloth_lot}. Skipping creation.")
        else:
            # --- Step 4: Create new CMPR record for this specific Job Card / Lot ---
            cmpr = frappe.new_doc("Coating Machine Production Record")
            cmpr.work_order = doc.work_order
            cmpr.job_card = doc.name
            cmpr.colour = frappe.db.get_value("Work Order", doc.work_order, "so_colour") or ""
            cmpr.cloth_article = frappe.db.get_value("Work Order", doc.work_order, "production_item") or ""
            cmpr.stores_issued_meters = total_fabric_qty
            cmpr.cloth_lot = cloth_lot

            # ✅ New Fields: Assign Quilon & Adhesive batch numbers
            cmpr.quilon_recd_from_stores_kgsbatch_no = quilon_batch or ""
            cmpr.glue_recd_from_stores_kgsbatch_no = adhesive_batch or ""

            # --- Step 5: Fetch BOM Spec values dynamically ---
            bom_no = frappe.db.get_value("Work Order", doc.work_order, "bom_no")
            cmpr.quilon_coating_gsm_spec = 0.0
            cmpr.adhesive_coating_gsm_spec = 0.0

            if bom_no:
                bom_items = frappe.get_all(
                    "BOM Item",
                    filters={"parent": bom_no},
                    fields=["item_code", "qty"]
                )
                for b in bom_items:
                    item_code = b.get("item_code") or ""
                    qty_val = to_float(b.get("qty"))
                    material_type = frappe.db.get_value("Item", item_code, "custom_material_type")

                    if material_type == "Quilon":
                        cmpr.quilon_coating_gsm_spec = qty_val
                    elif material_type == "Adhesive":
                        cmpr.adhesive_coating_gsm_spec = qty_val

            # --- Step 6: Save CMPR ---
            try:
                cmpr.insert(ignore_permissions=True, ignore_mandatory=True)
                frappe.msgprint(f"✅ CMPR {cmpr.name} created for Work Order {doc.work_order} (Lot: {cloth_lot})")
            except Exception as e:
                frappe.log_error("CMPR creation failed: " + str(e), "Job Card → CMPR Script Error")
                frappe.throw("CMPR creation failed: " + str(e))

script:
# -----------------------------------------------------
# Sales Order Auto Flow (No import used)
# -----------------------------------------------------

# Define constants
CUT_SUFFIX = "CUT"
LOG_SUFFIX = "LOG"
COATED_SUFFIX = "COATED"
DEFAULT_SUPPLIER = "Arun Textiles"
DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE = "FG - Cut - JG"

# ---------------- Helper Functions ----------------

def get_stock_qty(item_code):
    qty = frappe.db.get_value("Bin", {"item_code": item_code, "warehouse": DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE}, "actual_qty")
    return float(qty or 0)

def check_raw_material_availability(item_code, qty):
    bom = frappe.db.get_value("BOM", {"item": item_code, "is_default": 1}, "name")
    if not bom:
        return False
    bom_items = frappe.get_all("BOM Item", filters={"parent": bom}, fields=["item_code", "qty"])
    for b in bom_items:
        stock = get_stock_qty(b.item_code)
        if stock < b.qty * qty:
            return False
    return True

def create_work_order(item_code, qty, operation, sales_order):
    company = frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company")
    bom = frappe.db.get_value("BOM", {"item": item_code, "is_default": 1}, "name")
    if not bom:
        frappe.msgprint(f"No BOM found for {item_code}. Cannot create Work Order.")
        return

    wo = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "Work Order",
        "production_item": item_code,
        "qty": qty,
        "sales_order": sales_order.name,
        "company": company,
        "bom_no": bom,
        "description": f"Auto-created for {operation}"
    })
    wo.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    frappe.msgprint(f"🧩 Work Order created for {operation}: {wo.name}")

def create_purchase_order_for_rm(item_code, qty):
    bom = frappe.db.get_value("BOM", {"item": item_code, "is_default": 1}, "name")
    if not bom:
        frappe.msgprint(f"No BOM found for {item_code}. Cannot create Purchase Order.")
        return

    bom_items = frappe.get_all("BOM Item", filters={"parent": bom}, fields=["item_code", "qty"])
    items = []
    for b in bom_items:
        items.append({
            "item_code": b.item_code,
            "qty": b.qty * qty,
            "schedule_date": frappe.utils.nowdate()
        })

    po = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "Purchase Order",
        "supplier": DEFAULT_SUPPLIER,
        "transaction_date": frappe.utils.nowdate(),
        "items": items
    })
    po.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
    frappe.db.commit()
    frappe.msgprint(f"📦 Purchase Order created for missing raw materials: {po.name}")

# ---------------- Main Logic ----------------

for row in doc.items:
    item_name = row.item_name
    item_code = frappe.db.get_value("Item", {"item_name": item_name}, "name")
    if not item_code:
        frappe.throw(f"Item not found for name {item_name}. Please check item master.")

    req_qty = float(row.qty)

    # Derive related item names
    if CUT_SUFFIX in item_name:
        log_item_name = item_name.replace(CUT_SUFFIX, LOG_SUFFIX)
        coated_item_name = item_name.replace(CUT_SUFFIX, COATED_SUFFIX)
    elif LOG_SUFFIX in item_name:
        log_item_name = item_name
        coated_item_name = item_name.replace(LOG_SUFFIX, COATED_SUFFIX)
    else:
        frappe.msgprint(f"⚠️ Cannot resolve linked coated item for {item_name}. Please check naming or BOM link.")
        continue

    # Resolve item codes for related items
    log_item_code = frappe.db.get_value("Item", {"item_name": log_item_name}, "name")
    coated_item_code = frappe.db.get_value("Item", {"item_name": coated_item_name}, "name")

    if not log_item_code or not coated_item_code:
        frappe.msgprint(f"⚠️ Cannot find linked items for {item_name}. Please check item names.")
        continue

    # Stock check chain
    cut_stock = get_stock_qty(item_code)
    log_stock = get_stock_qty(log_item_code)
    coated_stock = get_stock_qty(coated_item_code)

    if cut_stock >= req_qty:
        frappe.msgprint(f"✅ Enough stock for {item_name} ({cut_stock}). No manufacturing required.")
    elif log_stock >= req_qty:
        create_work_order(log_item_code, req_qty, "Rewinding & Slitting", doc)
    elif coated_stock >= req_qty:
        create_work_order(coated_item_code, req_qty, "Log Roll Conversion", doc)
    else:
        if check_raw_material_availability(coated_item_code, req_qty):
            frappe.msgprint(f"🧾 RM available. Start coating for {coated_item_name}.")
            create_work_order(coated_item_code, req_qty, "Coating Process", doc)
        else:
            create_purchase_order_for_rm(coated_item_code, req_qty)

script:
def before_submit(doc, method):

    # Only for Scrap type
    if doc.custom_quilon_type != "Scrap":
        return

    # Only Stock Manager allowed
    if not frappe.has_role("Stock Manager"):
        frappe.throw("Only Stock Manager can submit this Scrap transaction.")

    # If pending, approve it
    if doc.custom_scrap_approval_status == "Pending":
        doc.custom_scrap_approval_status = "Approved"

        # Get Manufacturing Manager + Manufacturing User
        manufacturing_users = frappe.get_all(
            "User",
            filters={"role_profile_name": ["in", ["Manufacturing Manager", "Manufacturing User"]]},
            pluck="name"
        )

        # If no users found, send to Administrator
        if not manufacturing_users:
            manufacturing_users = ["Administrator"]

        subject = f"Scrap Approved – {doc.name}"

        # Create Notification Log (System Notification)
        for user in manufacturing_users:
            frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "Notification Log",
                "subject": subject,

for item in doc.get("po_items"):

    if not item.qty_to_produce or item.qty_to_produce <= 0:

    # Prevent duplicate Work Order

        {
            "production_plan": doc.name,
            "production_item": item.item_code,
            "sales_order": item.sales_order,

        }

    if not item.bom_no:

    # 🔥 Fetch BOM

    # 🔥 Copy Operations from BOM
    for op in bom_doc.operations:

            "time_in_mins": op.time_in_mins,
            "hour_rate": op.hour_rate,
            "batch_size": op.batch_size
        })

    # Insert Work Order in Draft
    wo.insert(ignore_permissions=True)

name: Batch Continue Sequence
script:
import frappe
import re

# Skip if batch name already manually entered
if doc.batch_id:
    
    item_code = doc.item

    # Fetch latest batch for same item
    latest_batch = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT batch_id
        FROM `tabBatch`
        WHERE item=%s
        ORDER BY creation DESC
        LIMIT 1
    """, (item_code,), as_dict=True)

    if latest_batch:
        last_batch = latest_batch[0].batch_id

        match = re.search(r'(\d+)$', last_batch)

        if match:
            last_num = int(match.group(1))
            new_num = last_num + 1

            doc.batch_id = f"{item_code}-{str(new_num).zfill(4)}"

        else:
            doc.batch_id = f"{item_code}-0001"

    else:
        doc.batch_id = f"{item_code}-0001"

name: Fix Quality Inspection Template Mapping
script:
if doc.quality_inspection_template:
    # Check if the document has been saved before
    is_new_doc = doc.get_doc_before_save() is None

    # Check if someone has already started typing readings to protect the data
    has_readings = False
    if doc.readings:
        first_row = doc.readings[0]
        # Checks if reading_1 or the single reading_value contains data
        if first_row.get("reading_1") or first_row.get("reading_value"):
            has_readings = True

    # ONLY run the reconstruction if it's a brand new creation step and has no entered readings
    if is_new_doc and not has_readings:
        # 1. Fetch template data directly
        template_params = frappe.get_all(
            "Item Quality Inspection Parameter",
            filters={"parent": doc.quality_inspection_template},
            fields=["specification", "custom_characteristics", "custom_checking_method", 
                    "numeric", "min_value", "max_value", "value"],
            order_by="idx asc"
        )
        
        if template_params:
            # Clear out whatever rows the wizard brokenly created
            doc.set("readings", [])
            
            # Re-build and force inject properties cleanly 
            for t_row in template_params:
                row = doc.append("readings", {})
                
                # Map correctly to clear the mandatory blocks
                row.characteristics = t_row.get("specification")
                row.specification = t_row.get("custom_characteristics")
                row.checking_method = t_row.get("custom_checking_method")
                
                row.numeric = t_row.get("numeric")
                row.min_value = t_row.get("min_value")
                row.max_value = t_row.get("max_value")
                row.value = t_row.get("value")
